reviewMethod: Visual inspection of all 150 front and 150 reverse renders in eight proof sheets; additional full-size sample inspection and collection overview review.
revisionsMade: Removed original-palette emission from derived paint materials.
Corrected bonnet icon orientation and texture wrapping at UV boundaries.
Excluded C006 and C013 for insufficient badge area and curated replacement selections.
Disabled optional supplier engine, spoiler, and turbine objects.
Included the neutral roof swatches of C012 in the theme paint.
Separated Wizard's navy/lavender palette from Royal's purple/gold palette.
limits: Review used isolated asset-preview cameras, not the eventual gameplay camera.
Badge size and mirrored placement are constrained by the original UVs; no meshes or UVs were changed.
Some original body shapes and integrated wings remain inherently sporty.
